column1: # Immutable squash SHA<TAB>reviewed signed source SHA<TAB>exact source signer email.
# This ledger is only for protected, shipped history that cannot be rewritten. The checker
# requires full lowercase SHAs, one row per immutable commit, and a real source commit with the
# exact declared @mail.build trailer. A squash must be single-parent and tree-identical to its
# source. A merge must have exactly two parents, reference its reviewed second parent as source,
# and match the clean synthetic merge tree exactly.
